title: Win remote roles, add a second stream, launch in 90 days

say: Win remote roles, add a second income stream, and launch your service in 90 days.
This is the video for module 3: Growing Your Digital Enterprise.
A remote job gives the steady income freelancing often lacks. The women who win are usually not the most talented. They apply precisely, and show remote-work habits from the first message.

say: A real employer interviews you on video, and the job also appears on the company's own website. A short test task is normal. A long one that looks like real unpaid work is not.

panel.heading: Real job or fake job?
left: Job is on the company website
right: Offered a job with no interview
Asks for BVN, bank login or OTP

say: Be very careful if the interview happens only by text on Telegram or WhatsApp, if you get the job with no real interview, or if they send a cheque to buy equipment. Never give your BVN, bank login or OTP.

say: A second stream protects you when clients are quiet, and the best one grows from what you already do. Ruth makes a Google Sheets cash book for small shop owners.
She values 20 hours of her time at 2,500 naira an hour, which is 50,000, and spends 15,000 on promotion.
Her total cost is 65,000 naira. She prices the template at 4,000. The platform keeps about 10%, so she keeps 3,600 per sale.
Break-even is total cost divided by what she keeps: 65,000 divided by 3,600 is 18.06. So she needs 19 sales. Every sale after that is profit.
You cannot control whether a client says yes. You can control how many good approaches you make. For example, Blessing offers CV writing from Jos, and tracks everything.

say: Remote work often means handling CVs, phone numbers and customer lists. The Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 sets rules for this. Collect only what you need.

panel.heading: Handle client data responsibly
items: Collect only the data you need
Keep files in your protected cloud folder
Delete or return data when the job ends
Tell the client at once if data is exposed

say: Keep files in your protected cloud folder, not in open WhatsApp groups.

say: Tell the client at once if their data may be exposed, for example if your phone is stolen. And never reuse one client's list for another client or your own marketing.

say: As you grow, other women need a first opportunity. You can train one woman in your skill.

panel.heading: Three ways to share the work

cards.d: Teach your skill to one woman who needs a first opportunity.
Pass on clients you cannot take to women you trust.
One handles design, another writing. Agree task, deadline, quality and pay in writing.

say: To remember. Apply precisely to roles open to you, and walk away from fake jobs. Work out break-even before you build a product. Count your approaches and review every 30 days. And protect client data as you bring other women along.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Apply precisely; read the location line
Never give BVN, bank login or OTP
Break-even = total cost ÷ amount kept per sale
Set activity targets; review every 30 days
Protect client data; lift other women
